planning.scope: tens/ones each0–9, values0–99. Five strict fixturekeys34/43/40/22/6. One-digit and repeated-digit examples explicit.
assumed: Relevant canonical integer/unit knowledge; the lesson supplies its pictures and quantity/reference-unit meanings. Adult reading/pointing allowed. No compulsory object naming, speech confirmation or irrelevant taps.
planning.concreteToRepresentation: Kymmenen merkittyä tikkua nipussa →3niput+4irrallista → kaksi paikkalaatikkoa kymmenet/ykköset →34ja30+4. Ei erillistä esinenimen tai puheen kuittausta.
planning.interaction: Native +/-10and+/-1 construction with direct single-digit fields. Separate source model and optional amount display support count↔numeral meaning.
planning.help: Each bundle contains10; headings identify the count of bundles and count of singles. Read given numeral as tens and ones, avoid general firstdigit rule.
planning.advanced: Explain two occurrences of2in22: same digit, values20and2; optional larger two-digit target.
planning.offline: Real10-stick bundles and singles; adult can prebundle/read.
planning.exit: Miksi40:ssa on nolla? Näytä neljän ja neljänkymmenen ero.
evidenceLimits: Normalized tens/ones representation only, not general hundreds or regrouping into unconventional decompositions.
Optional value display/model support does not establish independent explanation, physical bundling, retention or formal mastery.
